mapper.select: select idempotency_key, actor, request_hash, status, response_status, response_json, created_at, expires_at, lease_expires_at, owner_token from idempotency_record where idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} and expires_at > current_timestamp limit 1
mapper.update: update idempotency_record set status = 'COMPLETED', response_status = #{responseStatus}, response_json = #{responseJson}, lease_expires_at = null, owner_token = null where idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} and status = 'IN_PROGRESS' and owner_token = #{ownerToken}
